descriptions.zh: 我们发现了一处令人惊奇的时空裂隙。如果花时间研究其性质，我们或许能找到进一步探索的方式。我们无从得知里面究竟有什么。
descriptions.en: We have discovered an extraordinary rift in space and time. Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

descriptions.zh:
我们的人终于抵近到触手可及天空中裂缝的地方了。

也许花点时间研究其性质便可以找到进一步探索的方法。我们完全无从得知在它里面到底有什么。
descriptions.en:
Our people have finally reached far enough to touch the scar in our skies.

Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

sections.zh: 我们发现了一处令人惊奇的时空裂隙。如果花时间研究其性质，我们或许能找到进一步探索的方式。我们无从得知里面究竟有什么。
sections.en: We have discovered an extraordinary rift in space and time. Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

sections.zh:
我们的人终于抵近到触手可及天空中裂缝的地方了。

也许花点时间研究其性质便可以找到进一步探索的方法。我们完全无从得知在它里面到底有什么。
sections.en:
Our people have finally reached far enough to touch the scar in our skies.

Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

descriptions.zh: 一个神秘的物体出现了。我们相信我们对时空裂缝的探索引起了某个人或某个东西的注意。
descriptions.en: A mysterious object has appeared. We believe our exploration into the rifts between space and time has drawn the attention of someone, or something.

sections.zh: 我们没有获得必要的§Y裂隙探球§!科技去正确地开展我们的研究。
sections.en: We do not possess the §YRift Sphere§! technology necessary to correctly carry on with our research.

descriptions.zh: 一个神秘的物体出现了。我们相信我们对时空裂缝的探索引起了某个人或某个东西的注意。
descriptions.en: A mysterious object has appeared. We believe our exploration into the rifts between space and time has drawn the attention of someone, or something.

sections.zh: 这个设备似乎正在以某种仔细考量的方式慢慢调整自己。我们相信，随着时间的推移，它将完成它被设计去执行的任务。
sections.en: The device seems to be aligning itself slowly in a deliberate fashion. We believe that, over time, it will accomplish what it was designed to do.

sections.zh: 如果我们能够投入足够的科学研究来开发这个设备的潜力，我们相信可以加速其激活。
sections.en: If we were to dedicate enough scientific research to unlocking the potential of this device, we believe we can accelerate its activation.

sections.zh: 星界丝缕似乎可以对这个装置进行刺激。我们刺激得越多，它激活得就越快。
sections.en: Astral thread seems to stimulate the device. The more we expose it to, the faster its activation.

sections.zh: 我们没有获得必要的§Y裂隙探球§!科技去正确地开展我们的研究。
sections.en: We do not possess the §YRift Sphere§! technology necessary to correctly carry on with our research.

descriptions.zh: 星系中心的居民目前遭受一股未知势力的攻击，他们请求我们的帮助。如果他们失败，我们或许就再也无法知晓自己的命运。
descriptions.en: Under assault from an unknown force, the entities currently inhabiting the center of the galaxy have requested our assistance. Should they fall, we know not our fate.

sections.zh: 我们不进行干涉，任由冲突演变。
sections.en: We will let this conflict proceed without interference.

sections.zh: 如果我们将自己回收的星界丝缕交给这些存在，他们可以用它来加强自己的护盾。
sections.en: If we were to deliver our recovered astral thread to these beings, they could use it to fortify their shielding.

sections.zh: 异星天然气在这个存在的古怪泡泡中有放大效果。我们可以利用它来增强我们的武器。
sections.en: Exotic gases have amplified effects in this strange bubble of existence. We can use it to enhance our weaponry.

sections.zh: 我们必须消灭最后的入侵者，才能让无形异使正确地封印[Root.Target.GetName]恒星系。
sections.en: We must eliminate the last of the invaders for the Formless to properly seal the [Root.Target.GetName] system
